Data for IGX-MS samples were acquired using an UHPLC 1290 system (Agilent Technologies, Santa Clara, CA) coupled on-line to an Orbitrap Fusion or Orbitrap Fusion Lumos mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific, San Jose, CA).
Mass spectrometers were operated in a data-dependent mode (DDA).
Fragmentation was performed using in a stepped HCD collision energy mode... For the identification of DSSO signature peaks, peptides were fragmented using a fixed CID collision energy

Raw files were searched with the precursor mass tolerance set to 10 ppm
Cross-linking experiments were performed in triplicates.

Cross-linking experiments were performed in triplicates.
Sequencing grade trypsin was obtained from Promega (Madison, WI).
dehydrated gel pieces were subjected to alkylation buffer (50 mM AmBic, 54 mM iodoacetamide (IAA), pH 8.5)
developed a cross-linking workflow combining blue native PAGE with in-gel cross-linking mass spectrometry (IGX-MS).
Carbamidomethyl was set as fixed modification and oxidation (M) and acetylation (protein N-term) as variable modifications.
Readily run gels were briefly rinsed with ddH2O before gel bands of interest were excised and further cut into smaller pieces
excised gel bands were incubated in 50 µl PBS with or without 1.5 mM DSS for 30 min at room temperature (RT).
excised gel bands were incubated in 50 µl PBS with or without 1.5 mM DSS for 30 min at room temperature (RT).
After quenching of cross-linking reactions, the supernatant was removed, and gel pieces were briefly washed using ddH2O and subsequently subjected to standard in-gel digestion
